services.desc: USA Water Ski and Wake Sports Foundation Hall of Fame brings the history of watersports and its various disciplines to life. The USA Water Ski and Wake Sports Foundation Hall of Fame features historic memorabilia and equipment that runs the gamut from its earliest days to today. How early? How about a pair of the earliest water skis known - made from a barrel. services.name: Lakeland Escape Room
services.desc: Each room at Escapology will challenge your group to collaborate, communicate and problem solve, but you will have to do so within a certain amount of time. Challenge your family or friends during an afternoon or evening at Escapology Escape Rooms in Lakeland. Work together to find clues, solve puzzles, and unlock the locks that will free them from the escape room within the hour. All Escape Rooms are private, so you can book an experience with as little as 2 guests or as many as 8 guests. Best of all, they are open seven days a week. The ideal age range for Escape Rooms is 8 years and up, but younger children will still enjoy the experience if they have some awesome and helpful adults

blurb: Guests tour the 18-room Wonder House, a four-story concrete and stone home with unique architecture and macabre decor. Tours are guided by the owners and last about 1.5 hours. The house was built starting in 1926 and restored recently, featured on Netflix's Amazing Interiors.
extraNote: All tours must be scheduled in advance via the Wonder House website · Parking for the tour is located in the rear of the property, accessible via El Paso Trail.
